notes: Notes are cleaner cards, with a tidy Done / Edit / Delete toolbar on hover.
Header menus open on hover, with a new Cutnote menu for the website and GitHub.
Smoother opening and going back in the Library and Captions tabs, keeping your place.
Crisp custom sliders with a lime fill, a centred + on cards, and a plain black gradient behind white-text previews.
Redesigned Library and Captions tabs: search, collection chips, clear wide previews, a + button to add at the playhead, and a simple caption list with Use.
